culture.text: A small team of about 51 people, headquartered in Luzern, Switzerland, founded by Paul and Kelly Toms in 2007.
Staff often studied at UK universities such as Nottingham Trent, Derby, Nottingham and Liverpool John Moores.
Calls its approach people-first, built on long relationships with clients and candidates.
